mechanism_claims.claim_text: FITC-Anal 3-Pro distributes throughout fungal cells rather than remaining at the cell periphery, supporting cytoplasmic translocation/localization.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Anal 3-Pro in Candida albicans and Trichosporon beigelii confocal microscopy
direct_assay_types: confocal laser-scanning microscopy of FITC-labeled peptide
mechanism_claims.limitations: B. subtilis and E. coli localization is mentioned as data not shown; final claim is anchored to the imaged fungal-cell evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Anal 3-Pro binds chitin and peptidoglycan in the reported cell-wall-component binding assay, while no binding activity was observed with chitosan, cellulose, or beta-1,3-glucan.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Binding specificity is source-reported; no kinetic affinity constants are provided in local material.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Anal 3-Pro retards plasmid DNA migration at 600 ng peptide in the gel-retardation assay, while Anal 3 does not show band retardation in the same source context.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Anal 3-Pro plasmid DNA binding compared with Anal 3
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper states additional in vitro experiments would be needed to define how peptide-DNA interaction is mediated.
